title: Financial Volatility and Risk Forecasting Incorporating a Larger Number of Realized Measures
abstract: arXiv:2411.17136v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-frequency data have led to the development of numerous realized volatility measures, while standard Realized GARCH models typically rely on a single measure. This paper proposes three approaches to incorporate information from multiple realized measures within the Realized GARCH framework. First, we develop an autoencoder-enhanced Realized GARCH model that constructs a synthetic realized measure through nonlinear dimensionality reduction. Second, we propose a linear weighted Realized GARCH model that jointly estimates convex aggregation weights and model parameters. Third, we introduce a functional weighted Realized GARCH model based on parsimonious Beta weighting functions. Using approximately 22 years of data for 29 international equity indices, we evaluate the proposed methods in volatility, Value-at-Risk, and Expected Shortfall forecasting. translated_title: 融合多种已实现测度的金融波动率与风险预测
translated_abstract: 高频数据的发展催生了众多已实现波动率测度，而标准的Realized GARCH模型通常仅依赖单一测度。本文提出了三种在Realized GARCH框架内融合多个已实现测度信息的方法。第一，我们开发了一种自编码器增强的Realized GARCH模型，通过非线性降维构建合成已实现测度；第二，我们提出了一种线性加权Realized GARCH模型，可联合估计凸聚合权重与模型参数；第三，我们引入了一种基于简约Beta加权函数的函数型加权Realized GARCH模型。基于29个国际股指约22年的数据，我们在波动率、在险价值和预期损失预测方面对所提方法进行了评估。与基于单一已实现测度的基准模型相比，等权重……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出三种将多个已实现测度信息融入Realized GARCH框架的方法（自编码器增强、线性加权和基于Beta权重的函数型加权模型），并利用29个国际股指约22年的数据验证了其在波动率、在险价值和预期损失预测上优于单一测度基准模型的效果。
